scope: 11 HTTP URLs plus source inspection; reference project spicy-chat-platform read-only. Not a complete crawl or a ranking study.
method: Each of 20 applicable checks weighs 5. Values 0, 0.5, 1 are observed; U is unverified. Score=100*earned/verified weight; coverage=verified/applicable weight.
